title: The Stitching Paste on the Kite Tail
youtube_title: The Stitching Paste on the Kite Tail | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Some good things arrive only when they are not poked.
summary: At a greenhouse bench with seed pots and a south window, Gita wants to check on a kite tail with stitching paste before it is ready. With Auntie June nearby, Gita leaves it covered and does a quiet task instead, until it finishes in its own time.
